name: Tanashi Miyoko
source:
A girl who lost her parents in a traffic accident, went to an orphanage, and is now living with her father's teacher, [url=/c71706]Takano Hifumi[/url].

[spoiler]Miyoko Tanashi is the true identity of [url=/c3861]Takano Miyo[/url].[/spoiler]
